newsitem.title: UK: UK reserves fall underlying $113 mln in September.
newsitem.headline: UK reserves fall underlying $113 mln in September.

text.p: Britain's gold and currency reserves fell an underlying $113 million in September, the Treasury said. (IN MLN DOLLARS EXCEPT WHERE STATED)
Repayments under the Exchange Cover Scheme amounted to $8.0 million, while Ecu Treasury Bill proceeds of $1,268 million were offset by the same amount of bills maturing.

There was a repayment of the maturing $4.0 billion Floating Rate Note, which came to $3,095 million. The foreign exchange component of privatisation receipts was $148 million, the Treasury said. -- London Newsroom +44-171-542-8968
